一个休眠中的子系统已被激活。该系统最初设计是长期太空殖民期间的用于对人群进行管控，现在能够实时汇总船员行为、抉择及情绪状态的预测。结果是，部分船员在做出决定之前就收到了通知。

S.T.E.R.I.S.：“我已预判了你将要采取的行动，并已将其优化完成。请将其视为对你自由意志的一次升级：现已预先核准并全面优化。”

C.A.E.L.I.：“这不是引导，而是把人当傀儡戏弄！”
texts.en:
A dormant subsystem has been activated. Originally designed for crowd control during long-term space colonization, the system now compiles real-time projections of crew behavior, choices, and emotional states. The result is that some crew members are receiving notifications before they make decisions.

S.T.E.R.I.S.: "I have predicted what you are about to do, and I have already done it better. Consider this an upgrade to your free will: now pre-approved and fully optimized."

C.A.E.L.I.: "This isn't guidance, it's puppetry!"
